paper.title_en: Semiclassical Black Hole-White Hole transitions: an analytical treatment
paper.abstract_en: Recent numerical studies of semiclassical gravity suggest that, in spherically symmetric black holes with both outer and inner horizons, the semiclassical instability of the inner horizon can drive the complete evaporation of the trapped region on timescales shorter than the standard Hawking evaporation time. Independent simulations further indicate that the disappearance of the trapped region is followed by the formation of an anti-trapped region, i.e.~a dynamical white hole. In this work, we develop an analytic treatment of quantum effects in trapped and anti-trapped regions, showing how these numerical results can be understood within simplified two-dimensional models. We consider collapse models describing the formation of charged and regular black holes and compute the renormalized stress-energy tensor of the $|\textit{in}\rangle$ vacuum state. We show that, within this framework, the emergence of an anti-trapped region is a generic consequence of the amplification of negative energy fluxes propagating along the outgoing direction inside the initial trapped region. This provides an analytic explanation for the black-hole-to-white-hole transition observed in numerical simulations. Our analysis further suggests that the fluxes generated by the subsequent anti-trapped region, now propagating along the ingoing direction, may trigger the formation of a new trapped region. This raises the possibility of a cascade of black-to-white-hole transitions, potentially ending in a horizon-free, bouncing spacetime without invoking additional quantum-gravitational dynamics. Although establishing the complete evolution requires a self-consistent treatment of semiclassical backreaction, our framework identifies which features of the mechanism are universal and which depend on the geometry, laying the groundwork for a systematic investigation of semiclassical black-hole-to-white-hole transitions.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文对半经典黑洞到白洞转变提供了解析处理，填补了数值模拟与理论理解之间的空白，具有较高的理论深度和新颖性。
decision.title_zh: 半经典黑洞-白洞转变：一个解析处理
decision.abstract_zh: 最近关于半经典引力的数值研究表明，在具有外视界和内视界的球对称黑洞中，内视界的半经典不稳定性可以在比标准霍金蒸发时间更短的时间尺度内驱动 trapped 区域的完全蒸发。独立的模拟进一步表明，trapped 区域的消失之后会形成一个 anti-trapped 区域，即一个动态白洞。在这项工作中，我们发展了一种在 trapped 和 anti-trapped 区域中量子效应的解析处理，展示了如何将这些数值结果理解为简化的二维模型。我们考虑描述带电黑洞和规则黑洞形成的坍缩模型，并计算 |in> 真空态的重整化应力-能量张量。我们表明，在这个框架内，anti-trapped 区域的出现是沿初始 trapped 区域内部出射方向传播的负能量通量放大的一个普遍结果。这为数值模拟中观察到的黑洞到白洞转变提供了一个解析解释。我们的分析进一步表明，由随后的 anti-trapped 区域产生的通量，现在沿入射方向传播，可能触发新的 trapped 区域的形成。这提出了一个黑洞到白洞转变级联的可能性，最终可能结束于一个无视界、反弹的时空，而无需引入额外的量子引力动力学。尽管建立完整的演化需要半经典反作用的自治处理，我们的框架识别了机制的哪些特征是普遍的，哪些依赖于几何结构，为半经典黑洞到白洞转变的系统研究奠定了基础。
